lines.text: Let's print the receipt for a very normal coffee day.
Seven a.m. Cup one. Roughly a hundred milligrams of caffeine.
Eleven a.m. Cup two. Four p.m. Cup three.
Total: about three hundred. Under the FDA's four hundred a day for most adults.
So the amount isn't the problem. The time stamp is.
Four p.m. is six hours before a ten p.m. bedtime.
And in one sleep study, a strong dose of caffeine six hours before bed still cut into sleep.
Less sleep tonight, more coffee tomorrow. The receipt prints again.
You don't have to quit coffee. Just lighten the late cup.
RYZE Mushroom Coffee has about forty-eight milligrams of caffeine, less than half a regular cup, with six functional mushrooms.
